comments.author: jleveque
comments.body: Root cause is that there is no `get_change_event()` method defined for the dx010 platform in the platform's [Chassis class](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/device/celestica/x86_64-cel_seastone-r0/sonic_platform/chassis.py), so xcvrd falls back to try the old sfputil plugin, and `get_transceiver_change_event()` is [not implemented there](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/device/celestica/x86_64-cel_seastone-r0/plugins/sfputil.py#L204), either.

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: pmon service will not start on SONiC.master.478-23b0e07d, dx010-4. Is it the same issue?

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body:
@bingwang-ms: I just checked that device, and yes, this issue is present. However, it also appears that there is also a driver or hardware issue with that device, as I see errors like the following:

```
thermalctld IOError: Failed to read eeprom : [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/sys/class/i2c-adapter/i2c-12/12-0050/eeprom'
```

You might want to try rebooting and/or power-cycling the device.

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: Thanks @jleveque . Already rebooted the DUT, but the issue is still present. The file ```'/sys/class/i2c-adapter/i2c-12/12-0050/eeprom'``` is missing on DUT. Is this file included in image?

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body: @bingwang-ms: No. This is a device file. It should be created by the platform drivers. Either the drivers are not working properly or there is a hardware issue. I would check another device of the same platform running the same version of SONiC to see if the issue exists there, also.

linkedPullRequests.title: [device/celestica]: Add xcvrd event support for Seastone-DX010
linkedPullRequests.author: mudsut4ke
linkedPullRequests.body:
**- Why I did it**
- The xcvr service requires an event detection function, unplug or plug in the transceiver.

Fix #5853

**- How I did it**
- Add sysfs interrupt to notify userspace app of external interrupt
- Implement get_change_event() in chassis api.

**- How to verify it**
- Verify xcvrd running with error in syslog
- Verify port status and port information with this following command
  - `show interfaces status`
  - `show interfaces transceiver eeprom`
- Log : [xcvrd.log](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5534763/xcvrd.log)


**Signed-off-by**: Wirut Getbamrung [wgetbumr@celestica.com]
